summary: Framebuffer subsystem: initialises clock gating via therm, allocates MMU read/write scratch memory, configures page size via MMIO 0x100c80, manages framebuffer interrupts from MMIO 0x0100, flushes page initialisation to MMIO 0x100c10, and creates RAM objects for framebuffer memory.

dtor.what: Returns the internal gf100_fb struct pointer for cleanup of framebuffer resources

oneinit.what: Allocates MMU read and write scratch memory from instance memory with configurable size

init.what: Initialises clock gating by calling therm clkgate init with the clkgate_pack data table

init_page.what: Configures framebuffer page size by setting or clearing bit 0 of MMIO 0x100c80 for 16 or 17 bit page config

intr.what: Reads MMIO 0x0100 to check framebuffer interrupt flags PFFB and PBFB then logs if set

sysmem.flush_page_init.what: Writes the sysmem flush page address shifted by 8 bits to MMIO 0x100c10 to flush page init

ram_new.what: Initialises RAM sub-functions via gk104_ram_new_ to create framebuffer RAM objects

default_bigpage.what: Sets the default big page size exponent to 17 for framebuffer page allocation

clkgate_pack.what: Data table of clock gating parameters packed for therm clkgate init function
